title: Pesticides - Residues in foods - Cypermethrin, Deltamethrin, Fenvalerate and Permethrin - Method for determination
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes the gas chromatographic method for determination of synthetic pyrethroids, namely, cypermethrin, dehamethrin, fervalerate and permethrin residues in various food commodities.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
